notes: Reviewed factory authority table. pipelines/curate_identity.py loads this file from config/FACTORY-REGISTRY.json. Lookup is exact raw source-directory path_id then exact payload_factory; Hub publication names remain separate in the publisher and are not lookup aliases. There is no suffix rewrite or glob. Unknown path → identity.unknown_factory; registered path with missing or different meta.factory → identity.factory_path_payload_mismatch; kind not in the row's record_kinds → identity.factory_not_authorized_for_kind. Onboard a hosted generator by adding a reviewed registry row and adding or updating its exact generator/provider/channel assignment in pipelines/curate_identity.py _REVIEWED_GENERATOR_RIGHTS; both reviewed entries are required. Onboard a model-channel generator by adding the exact sealed row from schemas/model-channel-source-policy-v1.json and the matching _REVIEWED_GENERATOR_RIGHTS assignment; local_vllm, local_ollama, and openrouter_api identities never share rights with each other or with hosted/API channels. Identity retain is not publication and not training_ready.
